title: An open path
concept: PathOpen="true" on a GeometryPathType leaves the contour unclosed.

annotations.note: PathOpen="true" tells the renderer not to add the closing segment back to the first anchor. Flip it to false and the V would close into a triangle.
Three anchors, two segments: a chevron. The path stops at the last anchor instead of joining back to the first.
FillColor is Swatch/None and only the stroke is set, so the open contour reads as a line rather than a region.
